test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: G Krishnakumar was appointed chairman of which of the following in 2023?

options.text: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **G Krishnakumar** was appointed as the **chairman **of **Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL)** in **2023**.
 
• BPCL is a government-owned oil and gas corporation headquartered in Mumbai, India.
 
• The company operates two large refineries in the country, located in **Mumbai and Kochi**.
 
• BPCL is one of the largest companies in India and is listed on the Fortune Global 500 list of the world's biggest corporations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL)** was established in 1976 after the nationalization of the Burmah Shell.
 
• The company has a strong presence in refining, marketing, and distribution of petroleum products.
 
• BPCL has a wide network of retail outlets across the country and also operates in the upstream oil and gas exploration sector.
 
• BPCL's vision is to be the most admired global energy company leveraging talent and technology.
